facts.value: ASU has several aptitude requirements for admission, and one requirement that may be considered is your grades.
Some programs require even higher grades than the university does.
Meeting grade requirements is an important factor in being admitted.
If you’re interested in applying to Barrett, The Honors College, good grades are important.
Though Barrett doesn’t require a minimum GPA, it does take your grades into account and views them as a major factor in deciding on honors college admission.
There is no specific number of colleges you should apply to. It varies by student.
You should consider applying to more than one college.
Applying to two or more colleges will give you options if you don’t get admitted to your dream college.
The number of colleges you apply to could be limited by cost as most colleges require an application fee.
Most students take the ACT or SAT in the spring of their junior year, summer after their junior year or fall of their senior year.
You should also consider taking the PSAT in October of your junior year to be considered for National Merit and National Recognition Scholarship programs.
